snippet.title: 7Sigma Off-Grid
snippet.description:
“Not only do we show our Successes, we show our Failures too...”
We are a husband-and-wife team making the transition from life-long city dwellers to off-grid homesteaders. Along with our Belgian Malinois (Anu), we invite you to join us as we showcase the joys and challenges of homesteading in the beautiful Southern Sierra Nevada Mountains of California. 
You'll see us building and maintaining our homestead while making tons of mistakes along the way. Whether you're a city dweller considering a move to off grid living, or simply looking for a community of like-minded individuals, this channel has something for everyone.

snippet.title: Traumoto
snippet.description:
After years working as a trauma and emergency department registered nurse, I realized too many riders simply weren't prepared for the first few critical minutes after a crash.

So I started Traumoto.

I want to help riders and drivers gain the knowledge, confidence, and equipment to save a life, whether it's their own, a friend, or even a complete stranger.

Today, Traumoto kits are carried in nearly 60 countries, and together we've documented 14 lives saved.

If my videos help just one more person make it home safely, then every minute spent creating them is worth it.

🌐 Traumoto.com

snippet.title: Unreliable Prepper
snippet.description:
Welcome to Unreliable Prepper, the comedy-education sister channel to Reliable Prepper.

This channel exposes bad survival advice, untested gear, ridiculous prepper assumptions, and emergency plans that work perfectly until an emergency actually happens. We make fun of bad preparedness, not preparedness itself.

Expect realistic survival scenarios, dry humor, escalating consequences, gear failures, bug-out mistakes, food-storage disasters, blackout problems, and practical lessons you can use to strengthen your own emergency plan.

New videos three times a week.

Subscribe, turn on notifications, and discover which parts of your preparedness may exist only in your imagination.

snippet.description:
Deprem anında ne yapmalı? Yangın başladığında doğru adım ne? Acil durumda hangi ekipman hayat kurtarır?
Ben Serhat Yavuz, inşaat mühendisi ve iş güvenliği uzmanıyım. Bu kanalda deprem, yangın ve acil durum güvenliği ile ilgili pratik ve hayat kurtaran ipuçları paylaşıyorum.

Burada öğrenecekleriniz:

Deprem anında yapılması gerekenler:  evde, iş yerinde, metroda, denizde veya asansörde deprem anında hayatta kalma teknikleri

Yangın söndürme teknikleri: ABC, CO₂ ve köpüklü yangın söndürücü kullanımı, yangın dolapları, yangın spreyleri, yangın mendilleri

Acil durum planları: alarm sistemleri, tahliye planı, güvenli alanlara yönlendirme

Halat düğümleri: Camadan, açık/kapalı sekizli, günlük hayat ve kampta kullanabileceğiniz pratik teknikler

Hayat kurtaran güvenlik ipuçları: afet çantası, yangın tatbikatı, hazırlık önerileri

snippet.title: Charlie Survival
snippet.description:
I'm a Level 4 qualified First Responder (FREC 4), Hostile Environment training, advanced mountain navigation, bushcraft/survival, food safety, and wild butchery.
I’ve cycled solo and unsupported across Britain, with years of practical UK preparedness and survival experience rooted in a rural upbringing and farming family.  
This channel covers practical UK emergency preparedness, survival skills and honest gear testing - blackouts, emergency kits, first aid, water, power, communications, and realistic ways to become better prepared.  
No fearmongering. Just useful skills, solid equipment and practical UK prepping and survival.  
Join a fast-growing community of capable, like-minded people. 🦌

snippet.title: The Economic Ninja
snippet.description: Entrepreneur since I started selling candy in the 6th grade. I thrive on challenges, economics and business. I "flipped" quite a few homes in the early 2000s and have owned multiple rental properties, so I have a lot of personal experience with real estate transactions, loans, remodeling homes. I have "a super human thirst for economic knowledge." I spend many hours every day listening to and reading articles on market trends, interest rate cycles, and all aspects of economics and the world of finance. Then I found Silver Bitcoin, ETH, XRP and I was forever changed. I dove into crypto currencies back in '16. Finance is changing faster than you know. You can change with it or get steamrolled by it. My energy, knowledge and experience is what will make this YouTube channel a wild success. I will strive to be honest and real with my followers with one goal in mind, to help transform others into what they have always wanted to be and to make this life their best life possible.
